question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 8.
solution:
The correct answer is 'story.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence "***She reminded me of a witch from a children’s ___(8)___, with her long nose and staring eyes!***'' is indicating a witch from children's story.
 
• The use of the word ''children's'' in the sentence indicates the use of the word 'story'.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'story'.
 
• The word 'story' means **a description of people and events that are not real**. 
 
 
• Example:* My grandmother often reeled off one **story** after another*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete Sentence: *She reminded me of a witch from a children’s **story**, with her long nose and staring eyes!*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us explore the other options:

__
 
• 'Myth' means **an idea or story which many people believe but that does not exist or is false**. (मनगढ़ंत, काल्‍पनिक विचार या कथा)
 
• '**Anecdote**' means **a short interesting story about a real person or event**. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या घटना के विषय में रोचक लघुकथा; कि़स्‍सा चुटकला, लतीफ़ा)
 
• 'Epic' means **a long film, book, or other work portraying heroic deeds and adventures or covering an extended period of time**. (वीरगाथा, महान कथा)

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य "*She reminded me of a witch from a children’s ___(8)___, with her long nose and staring eyes!*'' बच्चों की कहानी से एक डायन का संकेत दे रहा है।
 
• वाक्य में 'children's' शब्द का प्रयोग 'story' शब्द के प्रयोग को दर्शाता है।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त शब्द 'story' है।
 
• 'Story' शब्द का अर्थ है **कथा या कहानी, क़िस्‍सा**। 
 
 
• उदाहरण: *My grandmother often reeled off one story after another*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: *She reminded me of a witch from a children’s story, with her long nose and staring eyes!*
